user.title: Connect to OpenBeken
user.description: Enter the device's IP address or hostname and native API port (default: 6054). The OpenBekenAPI driver must be running.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure OpenBeken
reconfigure.description: Enter the new IP address or hostname and native API port of the same device.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the address, port, network access and whether the OpenBekenAPI driver is running. The default port is 6054.
error.unsupported_protocol: This device advertises an unsupported API version. Use OpenBeken firmware with native API version 1, or check the address and port.
error.invalid_response: The endpoint did not return a valid OpenBeken greeting. Check the native API port (default: 6054) and the OpenBekenAPI driver.
error.wrong_device: The discovered address belongs to a different device. Discover it again or add the intended device manually. Existing settings have not been changed.

abort.already_configured: This OpenBeken device is already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: This device is already being configured. Complete the existing setup first.
abort.unsupported_protocol: The device advertises an unsupported API version. Use OpenBeken firmware with native API version 1.
abort.no_device_id: The device did not advertise an identifier. Check the firmware and the MDNS driver, or add the device manually.
abort.wrong_device: This address belongs to a different OpenBeken device. Add it as a separate integration. Existing settings have not been changed.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The connection settings have been updated.

cannot_connect.message: Could not connect to OpenBeken. Check the address, native API port (default: 6054), network and OpenBekenAPI driver. Home Assistant will retry automatically.

unsupported_protocol.message: The endpoint advertises an unsupported API version. Check the address and port, or use OpenBeken firmware with native API version 1.

invalid_response.message: The endpoint did not return a valid OpenBeken response. Check the native API port and the OpenBekenAPI driver.

wrong_device.message: The configured address belongs to a different device. Reconfigure the integration with the original device's address to preserve its entities.

command_timeout.message: The device did not confirm the command in time. Its state is uncertain; check the device before trying again.

device_unavailable.message: The device could not be reached. Check its network connection and address. Home Assistant will retry the connection automatically.

command_rejected.message: The device rejected the command. Check whether the firmware supports the requested action or light setting.

unsupported_protocol.title: Unsupported OpenBeken API for {name}
unsupported_protocol.description: The endpoint configured for {name} advertises an unsupported API version. Check its address and port via Settings → Devices & services → OpenBeken → Reconfigure. If they are correct, install OpenBeken firmware with native API version 1 and enable the OpenBekenAPI driver. Home Assistant retries automatically and removes this notice when the connection works.

wrong_device.title: A different OpenBeken device was found for {name}
wrong_device.description: The configured address now belongs to a different device. To preserve the entities and automations of {name}, open Settings → Devices & services → OpenBeken → Reconfigure and enter the original device's current address and port. Add a replacement device as a separate integration. This notice disappears once the original device reconnects.
